job.style: a conversation between a teacher and two students

passage: Teacher: Today, let’s clarify some common misunderstandings about social divisions. Rohan, do you think the sexual division of labour is a natural biological necessity? Rohan: Yes, I believe women are naturally better at domestic work. Teacher: Actually, that is a social construct, not a biological one. The division of labour is assigned by society, not nature. Priya, what about communalism? Is it just being religious? Priya: I think communalism means being very religious and following all rituals. Teacher: That is incorrect. Communalism is when one religion is presented as superior to others, leading to conflict. Being religious is a personal choice, but communalism is a political ideology. Finally, let’s discuss political representation. Many students believe women have 33% reservation in the Lok Sabha. In reality, women’s representation in the Lok Sabha has never reached even 15 percent. Regarding caste, while it often creates tension, it can also give marginalized groups a platform to voice their demands and gain political power. It is not always purely negative. It is a complex tool for social justice and political mobilization.

items.evidence: The division of labour is assigned by society, not nature.
items.q: Why do women in many homes do most of the cooking and cleaning?
options: Society has assigned that work to women
Women are born better at household tasks
Biological differences force girls into household work
Women alone choose it, so no one assigns it
items.explain: The division of labour is assigned by society, not by nature or biology.

wrong.why: thinks the division of labour is natural
thinks gender division is only biological difference
thinks society plays no part in the roles

items.evidence: Communalism is when one religion is presented as superior to others, leading to conflict.
items.q: What makes a belief communal rather than just religious?
options: It treats one religion as superior to others
It involves following every ritual very strictly
It is found only in the majority community
It means praying together in public places
items.explain: Communalism presents one religion as superior and leads to conflict; being religious is only a personal choice.

wrong.why: thinks communalism means being very religious
thinks only the majority can be communal

items.evidence: In reality, women’s representation in the Lok Sabha has never reached even 15 percent.
items.q: Ria says women hold one-third of Lok Sabha seats. How would you correct her?
options: Women have never held even 15 percent of seats
Women hold 33 percent of seats by reservation
Women hold many seats because they vote more
Women hold nearly half the seats, matching their numbers
items.explain: Women's share in the Lok Sabha has never reached even 15 percent, so there is no 33 percent.

wrong.why: thinks women have 33% reservation in the Lok Sabha
links high representation to women voting
assumes seats match the population share

items.evidence: Regarding caste, while it often creates tension, it can also give marginalized groups a platform to voice their demands and gain political power.
items.q: How can caste in politics help marginalized groups?
options: It gives them a voice and political strength
It decides every election in favour of their caste
It removes caste from society once they vote
It never helps them, as caste only divides
items.explain: Caste can give marginalized groups a platform to voice demands and gain political power.

wrong.why: thinks elections are decided only by caste
thinks caste disappears through political action
thinks caste in politics is always negative
